title: Parsons and Hubbard's Babylon Working

tellings.quote: The most infamous of these was the Babylon Working, an attempt to summon the divine feminine archetype known as Babylon.

plain: In 1946 in Pasadena, the rocket scientist Jack Parsons and L. Ron Hubbard, the man who later founded Scientology, carried out a magic ritual called the Babylon Working, an attempt to summon a divine female figure known as Babylon. Michels tells it himself, linking it to the English occultist Aleister Crowley and his novel Moonchild, as part of a case that occult practice was tangled up in the early American space program.
